EPGK (Disk, Console, Reader, Punch, or Printer)
FETCH LOWER REGISTERS may be used with its corresponding pseudo-op, STORE
LOWER REGISTERS, to allow the user to examine the contents of mainstream lower
registers and to alter them if he chooses.
$FELR will fetch the lower registers, describing the status of the last problem pro-
gram interrupt, into a thirty-one word program buffer.
